categoryTemplates.SWEETENER: A sweetening agent used to add flavor and sweetness to food products.
categoryTemplates.PRESERVATIVE: A substance added to food products to prevent decay or spoilage and extend shelf life.
categoryTemplates.EMULSIFIER: An additive that helps mix and stabilize ingredients that would otherwise separate, such as oil and water.
categoryTemplates.STABILIZER: An additive that maintains the physical texture, structure, and consistency of food products.
categoryTemplates.ACIDITY_REGULATOR: An ingredient used to control or alter the acidity or alkalinity of food products.
categoryTemplates.FLAVOUR_ENHANCER: A compound added to foods to enhance their existing savory or sweet flavors.
categoryTemplates.OIL: A fat source commonly used for texture, moisture, or cooking in processed foods.
categoryTemplates.COLORING: A food additive used to impart or restore color to food products.
categoryTemplates.ADDITIVE: A general food additive used for technological purposes during processing.
categoryTemplates.UNKNOWN: An ingredient with an unspecified category or primary function.
